style.name: no-em-dash
style.criterion: The message holds no em-dash outside code.

style.name: no-paren-aside
style.criterion: The message holds no parenthetical aside outside code.

style.name: headers
style.criterion: The message holds no header under 500 words and at most three headers above 500 words.

style.name: sentence-length
style.criterion: At most 10 percent of sentences exceed 25 words and no sentence exceeds 40 words.

style.name: bold-leadins
style.criterion: Every paragraph after the first and every top-level bullet opens with a bold lead-in or a backticked name.

style.name: no-flattery
style.criterion: The message holds no flattery or filler phrase from a fixed list.

explanation.name: conclusion-first
explanation.criterion: The first block is an unlabeled prose conclusion of at most three sentences with no preamble.

explanation.name: section-order
explanation.criterion: Labeled sections appear in template order.

explanation.name: sections-labeled
explanation.criterion: Every numbered list sits under a bold or header label.

explanation.name: close-last
explanation.criterion: The last block is a labeled close and nothing follows it.

explanation.name: timeline-bounds
explanation.criterion: Every full timeline holds 4 to 8 steps and at least one full timeline exists.

explanation.name: step-sentences
explanation.criterion: Every timeline step holds at most two sentences.

fix.name: has-failing-timeline
fix.criterion: A section labeled Timeline without the fix exists.

fix.name: has-fixed-timeline
fix.criterion: A section labeled Timeline with the fix exists.

fix.name: fixed-starts-at-divergence
fix.criterion: Each fixed timeline states diverges at step N and its first step is step N.

fix.name: has-what-changes
fix.criterion: A section labeled What changes exists.

fix.name: change-bullets
fix.criterion: Every bullet under What changes opens with a backticked file or component name.

fix.name: no-alt-timeline
fix.criterion: No numbered list follows an Alternative label.
